** **Job Summary:** The Director of Process and Industrial Engineering provides strategic and technical leadership for process engineering, industrial engineering, manufacturing optimization, and continuous improvement across foundry operations. Accountable for improving safety, quality, productivity, capacity, delivery performance, and cost competitiveness.
**Duties And Responsibilities
**
* Performance Management & Results – Establish, monitor, and improve key manufacturing performance measures across Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Continuous Improvement, including safety, quality, scrap and rework, throughput, labor productivity, equipment utilization/OEE, downtime, process capability, delivery, manufacturing cost, capital ROI, continuous
improvement savings, and energy/material utilization.
* Manufacturing Process Leadership - Establish and maintain standardized manufacturing processes, parameters, specifications, work instructions, standards, and control plans.
* Process Improvement - Improve process capability; reduce variation, scrap, rework, downtime, and manufacturing cost.
* Process Development - Lead process development for new products/transfers and support feasibility, manufacturability, and launches.
* Industrial Engineering Analysis - Analyze capacity, labor/equipment utilization, production flow, costs, cycle times, and labor standards.
* Capacity & Productivity Optimization - Develop capacity models, productivity measures, facility layouts, material-flow plans, and bottleneck solutions.
* Continuous Improvement - Lead company-wide continuous improvement using Lean, Kaizen, 6S, root-cause analysis, 5-Why, fishbone, Pareto, and SPC.
* Capital & Manufacturing Technology - Develop capital proposals, ROI analyses, and evaluate automation, robotics, material handling, process monitoring, and digital manufacturing.
* Quality & Operations Partnership - Partner with Quality and Operations on process controls, defects, corrective actions, customer issues, and first-pass yield.
* People Leadership - Lead, coach, and develop Process and Industrial Engineering personnel; set goals, expectations, and development plans.

Delta Precision Components, LLC and its’ divisions of Delta Gear and Delta Research is a growing manufacturer of advanced gears, precision gears, shafts, splines, carriers, housings, gauges and & other components and assemblies for primarily the aerospace and defense industry. We are AS9100 and ISO9001-registered facility.
For over 40 years, we’ve built a culture of stability and growth—now we are looking for passionate individuals to join our team and grow with us.
**WHY JOIN US?**
At our core, quality is about more than compliance—it's about safely putting people in the air. This is a unique opportunity for a results-driven leader to challenge the status quo, drive measurable improvements and build organizational capability.
If you are passionate about continuous improvement, operational excellence, and leading meaningful change, you'll play a critical role in strengthening customer confidence, improving business performance, and shaping the next chapter of our growth.
**Summary**
Reporting to the Vice President, Quality, the incumbent will lead the company's quality strategy, systems, and culture. Responsible for ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. Responsible for leadership for quality professionals.
**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute the company's quality vision, strategy, and performance objectives.
* Lead Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supplier Quality, and Continuous Improvement.
* Maintain compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry quality standards, including AS9100.
* Drive customer satisfaction through proactive quality management, problem resolution, and performance improvement.
* Champion root cause analysis, corrective actions, risk mitigation, and defect prevention.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to improve operational excellence and business performance.
* Lead customer audits, internal audits for site and division, management reviews, and quality system assessments.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in aerospace, automotive, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated success developing and leading certified quality management systems and customer-focused quality initiatives.
* Strong leadership, communication, change management, and customer relationship skills.
* Proven record of driving measurable improvements in quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance.
* Broad experience that includes start-up, multi-site, acquisitions and significant business transformation.
